'''''Murbeckiella sousae''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the mustard family [[Brassicaceae]], [[endemic]] to the central and northern mountains of continental [[Portugal]]. It inhabits cracks in rocks, escarpments, embankments of paths. On siliceous substrates, mainly [[schist]]s, in mountain areas.<ref name="iucn status 19 November 2021" />
